test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pay an arm and a leg for something

options.text: Pay a lot of money for something
Give a lot of love and care to someone
Pay a lot of attention to an incident

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Pay a lot of money for something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Pay an arm and a leg for something"** means to pay a lot of money for something. (किसी चीज़ के लिए बहुत पैसे देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He had to pay an arm and a leg for that vintage car.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Pay a lot of money for something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Be devoted to unwanted things** (अनचाही चीजों के प्रति समर्पित होना)
 
 
• **Example:** She tends to be devoted to unwanted things, cluttering her house with unnecessary items.
 
 
 
• **Give a lot of love and care to someone** (किसी को बहुत सारा प्यार और देखभाल देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a lot of love and care to the stray dog she found on the street.
 
 
 
• **Pay a lot of attention to an incident** (किसी घटना पर बहुत ध्यान देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The media paid a lot of attention to the recent political scandal.
